name: Baglioni Masseria Muzza
positioning: Baglioni Masseria Muzza Resort & Spa: an 18th-century masseria near Otranto in the Salento countryside, surrounded by olive groves, with whitewashed interiors and Aura Spa
best_for: Travelers who want a countryside masseria base near Otranto with shuttle access to Salento beaches
Families wanting family suites and a kids club
Spa-goers drawn to a water circuit with Turkish bath, Finnish sauna and Kneipp path

facts.text: Baglioni Masseria Muzza is near Otranto, deep in the Salento countryside, surrounded by olive groves.
The hotel is an 18th-century masseria in the Salento countryside.
Whitewashed walls and exposed wooden beams define the rooms and suites.
The Junior Suite Sunset View has exposed stone ceilings and authentic furnishings.
The Deluxe Room has a bathroom with a chromotherapy shower and a private patio with sun loungers.
The Otranto Family Suite has a living area, two double bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms and a furnished veranda.
The spa offers the Affusione di Levante water ritual.
The hotel has a Fitness Center with modern equipment.
The Baglioni Kids Club offers sports, games, arts and crafts and entertainment for young guests.
The Sunset Bar looks out over the hills, olive groves and the Alimini lakes at sunset.
Experiences offered include an e-bike tour of Otranto and its surroundings.
Experiences offered include a yacht experience along the Santa Maria di Leuca coast.

highlights.text: The spa's Water Journey includes a hydromassage pool, Turkish bath, Finnish sauna, Kneipp path and sensory showers.
Hotel guests have access to The Water Journey as part of their stay.
The Deluxe Sunset View room has a private patio overlooking the Salento sunsets.
Experiences offered include kayaking and snorkelling at Roca Vecchia.
Experiences offered include an olive oil tasting with picnic.

considerations.text: The hotel is in the countryside; Salento beaches and the center of Otranto are reached by the hotel's shuttle.
Access to the spa and fitness center is restricted to guests over 18; minors need an accompanying adult who has signed a liability waiver.
WhataHotel notes the remote countryside location requires a car for exploring nearby towns.
